label: Google Drive
description: Arcade.dev LLM tools for Google Drive

tools.name: CheckFileAccess
tools.description:
Check whether this app can already read each of several Drive files, in one batched
pre-flight call, before attempting to read them.

Use this when the user references multiple files, to learn which are readable up front
instead of hitting a separate access error for each one. Where this app reaches files
one grant at a time, the ungranted ones can then be granted together in a single picker
step. Each input may be a bare file id or a full Google Drive/Workspace URL (documents,
spreadsheets, slides, PDFs, images, folders — any type).

Returns ``files`` (a per-id list with ``accessible``, the ``title`` and ``mime_type``
when the file was read, and a ``reason`` when not usable), ``all_accessible`` (true only
when every id is already accessible), ``connected_account_email`` (the connected Google
account, empty when unknown), and a ``grant`` block. ``grant`` lists the ungranted
ids (``ungranted_ids``) plus, when the inline picker is enabled, a single picker URL
covering them all. Where this app already reaches every file the account can open there
is no per-file grant to make, so ``ungranted_ids`` stays empty and only ``access_hint``
comes back.

A ``reason`` of ``not_accessible_or_not_found`` is a file this app cannot read: one not
granted to it yet, one that does not exist, or one the connected account itself cannot
open — indistinguishable here. Empty ``ungranted_ids`` means no grant
step exists, so treat those ids as not found rather than asking the user to grant them.
``invalid_reference`` is an input that is not a Drive id or link at all; ask the user to
re-check it. ``error`` is a transient server-side failure (a timeout or 5xx) that no
grant can fix; the same inputs may be retried later.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: The files to check access for, each given as a bare Drive file id or a full Google Drive/Workspace URL (the id is extracted from the URL). Provide at most 50 per call; split larger lists across multiple calls.

output.description: Per-id accessibility (`files`), an `all_accessible` flag, the `connected_account_email` (the Google account this app is connected through), and a `grant` block. `grant` lists the ungranted ids with one consolidated picker URL when a per-file grant can help; where this app already reaches every file the account can open there is none to make, so `ungranted_ids` stays empty and only an `access_hint` comes back.

tools.name: CreateFolder
tools.description:
Create a new folder in Google Drive.

By default, parent folder paths are resolved in My Drive. For shared drives, use folder IDs
or provide shared_drive_id.

parameters.name: folder_name
parameters.description: The name of the new folder to create

parameters.name: parent_folder_path_or_id
parameters.description: The parent folder path like folder/subfolder or folder ID where to create. If providing a path, it will be resolved within My Drive by default. Do not include the folder to create in this path. Defaults to the root of My Drive.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If creating in a shared drive and using a parent folder path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using folder IDs or creating in My Drive. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: Created folder information including ID, name, web view link, and location path

tools.name: DownloadFileChunk
tools.description:
Download a byte range of a file's raw content from Google Drive, as base64.

The file preview reads files through this, and another tool that takes a file's bytes can
too. The user sees nothing it returns: when the user wants to see, save, download or export
a file, get the file instead, which is also how to read its text. Call repeatedly with
increasing start_byte values to retrieve the complete file. A Google Workspace file is
exported, and its ranges are ranges of the export.

Returns the chunk content as base64, along with progress information including
whether this is the final chunk.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID to download a chunk from. A folder downloads as a zip of its files. If providing a path, it will be resolved within 'My Drive' by default.

parameters.name: start_byte
parameters.description: The starting byte position for this chunk (0-indexed).

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: The size of the chunk to download in bytes. Max 5MB (5242880). Defaults to 5MB (5242880).

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

parameters.name: export_format
parameters.description: Export a Google Workspace file, such as a Doc, Sheet or Slides deck, in this format and download a range of the export. Other files always download as they are, and giving a format for one is an error. Defaults to PDF, or to the file's only format when it has no PDF.

parameters.name: export_checksum
parameters.description: The export_checksum returned with the first chunk of an export. Every chunk of an export after the first must carry it, and a chunk of an export that changed since then is refused. Defaults to no checksum, which only an export's first chunk may use.

output.description: Chunk content (base64 encoded), byte range info, and progress details

tools.name: DownloadFileThumbnail
tools.description:
Download the thumbnail Google Drive made of a file, as a base64 encoded image.

The file preview shows thumbnails; the image comes back to you as base64 text, which you
can't view. A thumbnail pictures the first page of a document or a frame of a video,
up to 1600 pixels on its longer side. Google Drive makes them for most images, videos,
PDFs, Microsoft Office files and Google Workspace files.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The path (folder/subfolder/filename) or ID of the file whose thumbnail to download. A path is resolved within My Drive unless shared_drive_id is given.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: The thumbnail image (base64 encoded) and its MIME type

tools.name: GenerateGoogleFilePickerUrl
tools.description:
Generate a URL where the user can grant this app access to specific Drive files.

Check `url` first. An empty `url` means this app already reaches every file the
connected account can open, so there is no per-file grant to request: this tool cannot
change any outcome, and a file that could not be read is one the account itself cannot
open. Do not retry it.

Otherwise the URL opens Google's first-party Drive picker, where the user selects which
files to share with this application — it is not a sign-in or credential prompt. By
default the picker shows files of all types; pass ``file_types`` to restrict it to
specific types. Use this when a prior tool reported that a file was not found or access
was denied, and the user expects the file to exist. After the user completes the picker
flow, retry the prior tool.

parameters.name: file_types
parameters.description: Restrict the picker to these Google Drive file types. Defaults to letting the user pick files of any type.

output.description: Google File Picker URL for user file selection and permission granting

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: GetFile
tools.description:
Get a Google Drive file: the user sees it in a preview where they can view it, save it,
or open it in Google Drive, and you get its details and its text, and its bytes when you
ask for them. Not every app shows the preview, so whenever the user wants the file, also
give them its download_link, or its web_view_link when that is null.

You get a Google Doc as Markdown, the first sheet of a Google Sheet as CSV, a Slides deck,
a Site or a text file as plain text, an Apps Script project as JSON, and the items in a
folder. With include_content, a file that isn't a Google Workspace file, such as an image,
a PDF or a Microsoft Office file, comes as base64 content when it's 5 MB or smaller; a
larger one downloads in byte ranges. The preview shows Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drawings as
PDFs and plays Google Vids videos. Files up to 20 MB can be saved from it, Google Workspace
files in any of their export formats and folders as a zip; larger files show Google Drive's
thumbnail and download from Google Drive. Use this whenever the user wants to see, open,
download, save, export, or get a file, and whenever you need to read one.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The path (folder/subfolder/filename) or ID of the file to get. A path is resolved within My Drive unless shared_drive_id is given.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

parameters.name: export_format
parameters.description: Offer a Google Workspace file for saving in this format first, such as docx when the user asks for a Word file. Other files save as they are, and a format the file can't be exported in leaves its first format first. Defaults to the file's first format, which is PDF when it has one.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Return the file's text from this character on, the next_offset of an earlier call. Each call returns at most 50,000 characters, and only a call from 0 returns the file's content. Defaults to 0, the start.

parameters.name: include_content
parameters.description: Also return the file's bytes as base64 content, for a file that isn't a Google Workspace file and is 5 MB or smaller. The bytes aren't needed to show the user the file or let them download, save or export it, since the preview and the download link do that, or to read the file's text or details, which come without them, and some apps don't show the preview when the bytes come along. Set this only when you need the bytes themselves, such as to hand the file to another tool. Defaults to False.

output.description: The file's name, type, size, Google Drive link and download link, the formats a Google Workspace file exports in and the one the preview saves in first, the file's text when it has text, its bytes as base64 when you asked for them and it isn't a Google Workspace file and is at most 5 MB, why either couldn't be read, and for a folder the items in it. A Google Workspace file has no size, and its download link exports it in the format the preview saves in first.

tools.name: GetFileTreeStructure
tools.description:
Get the file/folder tree structure of the user's entire Google Drive.
Very inefficient for large drives. Use with caution.

parameters.name: include_shared_drives
parameters.description: Whether to include shared drives in the file tree structure. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: restrict_to_shared_drive_id
parameters.description: Only include files from this shared drive in the file tree structure. Defaults to every drive the other settings include.

parameters.name: include_organization_domain_documents
parameters.description: Whether to include documents from the organization's domain. This is applicable to admin users who have permissions to view organization-wide documents in a Google Workspace account. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort order. Defaults to listing the most recently modified documents first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of files and folders to list. Defaults to listing all files and folders.

output.description: A dictionary containing the file/folder tree structure in the user's Google Drive

tools.name: ListFilePermissions
tools.description:
List permissions on a Google Drive file or folder.

Returns the individual people (and groups) with access and the current General access
(link sharing) state. `general_access` is computed across the ENTIRE file regardless of
filtering -- so "is this doc public?" is always answered authoritatively.

When `roles` is provided, `people` and `total_people` reflect only collaborators whose
role matches the filter. Truncated collaborators beyond `limit` are not returned;
`has_more` indicates whether truncation occurred.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID to inspect. If providing a path, it will be resolved within My Drive by default.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of user/group collaborators to include in the `people` list (1-500). Regardless of this cap, `general_access` reflects the entire file. Defaults to 100.

parameters.name: roles
parameters.description: Filter the `people` list to those holding one of these roles. For 'who can write?' pass [owner, writer]; for 'who can comment?' pass [owner, writer, commenter]. When provided, `total_people` reflects the count MATCHING the filter (not the whole ACL). Defaults to all roles.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: File permissions including per-person grants and the current General access (link) state

tools.name: MoveFile
tools.description:
Move a file or folder to a different folder within the same Google Drive.

Can move to a folder (keeping name), or move and rename in one operation. By default, paths
are resolved in My Drive. For shared drives, use file IDs or provide shared_drive_id.

parameters.name: source_file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The source file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID of the file to move. If providing a path, it will be resolved within 'My Drive' by default.

parameters.name: destination_folder_path_or_id
parameters.description: The path to the file's parent folder (exclude the file to be moved) or parent folder ID to move the file into. Defaults to the root of the drive.

parameters.name: new_filename
parameters.description: New name for the file after moving. Defaults to keeping the original name.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If working with paths in a shared drive, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using IDs. Defaults to resolving paths in My Drive.

output.description: Confirmation with the file's ID, name, and new location

tools.name: RemoveOtherCollaborators
tools.description:
Remove all user collaborators (and optionally groups) from a Google Drive file.

The file owner and the calling user are always preserved. Groups are preserved by default
because the Drive API cannot verify group membership -- pass include_groups=True to opt in.
Inherited shared-drive permissions are never removable from the file level and are skipped.

Use except_people to preserve additional people or groups by email or name. Ambiguous or
unmatched except_people entries raise an error to avoid accidentally removing someone the
caller meant to keep.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID. If providing a path, it will be resolved within My Drive by default.

parameters.name: except_people
parameters.description: Emails or names of people (or groups) to preserve. The file owner and the caller are always preserved automatically. Defaults to removing everyone else.

parameters.name: include_groups
parameters.description: Whether to also remove group permissions. The Drive API does not expose group membership, so the tool cannot verify the caller is not a member of a group it is about to delete, and removing a group can lock the caller out even though the tool preserves their personal email. Opt in with True only when you have confirmed group removal is safe. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: Summary of removed and preserved permissions

codeExample.tabLabel: Call the Tool with User Authorization

tools.name: RevokeFileAccess
tools.description:
Revoke access for specific people or groups on a Google Drive file.

Identifies matches by email (exact, case-insensitive) or display name. When an input
matches multiple people, the clear matches are still revoked and the ambiguous input is
surfaced in the `ambiguous` response field with candidate details so the agent can
re-prompt the user for just the uncertain ones. Inputs that don't match any collaborator
are returned in `not_found`. Pending-owner matches (mid-ownership-transfer) are skipped
and surfaced in `skipped_pending_owner` so the clean revokes in the batch still land.
Owner permissions cannot be revoked -- transfer ownership first.

When a grantee has both a direct and an inherited permission (e.g., shared-drive member
also granted directly on the file), revoking the direct row leaves the inherited access
intact. The inherited row is surfaced in `skipped_inherited` so callers don't assume the
grantee is fully removed -- inherited access must be adjusted at the shared drive level.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID. If providing a path, it will be resolved within My Drive by default.

parameters.name: people
parameters.description: Emails or names of people (or groups) to remove access from. Emails match exactly; names use case-insensitive matching on display name, then first/last name token.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: Summary of revoked permissions, including any inputs that could not be matched

tools.name: SearchFiles
tools.description:
Search for files in Google Drive.

The provided 'query' should only contain the search terms.
The tool will construct the full search query for you.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The exact search query to send to the Google Drive API to find files in Google Drive. The tool will construct the query for you. Will search for filenames and file contents that match the provided query.

parameters.name: folder_path_or_id
parameters.description: Search only within this specific folder. Provide either a path like folder/subfolder or a folder ID. Defaults to searching across all accessible locations.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: Search only within this shared drive. Defaults to searching My Drive, plus all shared drives when include_shared_drives is true.

parameters.name: include_shared_drives
parameters.description: If True and shared_drive_id is not set, include all shared drives in search. Defaults to False (My Drive only).

parameters.name: include_organization_domain_documents
parameters.description: Whether to include documents from the organization's domain. This is applicable to admin users who have permissions to view organization-wide documents in a Google Workspace account. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Sort order for search results. If the query contains 'fullText', then the order_by will be ignored. Defaults to listing the most recently modified documents first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of search results to return (1-50). Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: file_types
parameters.description: Only include files of these types. Defaults to all file types.

output.description: Search results containing matching files from Google Drive with metadata and file information

tools.name: SetGeneralAccess
tools.description:
Change the 'General access' (link sharing) setting on a Google Drive file.

Idempotent: calling with the same state as the current configuration is a no-op. When access
is 'domain', the link is scoped to the caller's email domain -- NOT the file owner's domain.
For cross-org collaboration (e.g., editing a file owned by another organization), confirm
with the user which domain they intend before calling. Google will reject domain sharing
for personal accounts (gmail.com, outlook.com, etc.) -- the tool translates that rejection
into a friendly error.

The response's `access` and `role` fields report the EFFECTIVE state after the transition,
not the requested state. For files on shared drives, inherited link permissions cannot be
changed from the file level -- if the request would have required removing an inherited
permission, the effective state will reflect the inherited permission that remained. When
`skipped_inherited` is non-empty, inspect it to understand why effective state may differ
from what was requested.

parameters.name: file_path_or_id
parameters.description: The file path like folder/subfolder/filename or the file ID. If providing a path, it will be resolved within My Drive by default.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: The new General access setting. 'restricted' removes link sharing, 'domain' shares with the caller's Google Workspace domain, 'anyone' makes it public with the link. Defaults to 'restricted'.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: The role granted via the link when access is 'domain' or 'anyone'. Ignored when access is 'restricted'. Constrained to reader, commenter, or writer, because Drive rejects owner and organizer roles on link permissions. Defaults to reader (view-only).

parameters.name: allow_discovery
parameters.description: Whether the file should be discoverable through search. Only meaningful when access is 'domain' or 'anyone'. Defaults to False.

parameters.name: shared_drive_id
parameters.description: If the file is in a shared drive and using a path, provide the shared drive ID. Not needed when using file IDs. Defaults to resolving the path in My Drive.

output.description: New General access state, including previous state for reference

summary:
The Google Drive toolkit lets Arcade-powered agents read, write, organize, and share files and folders across My Drive and shared drives using Google's Drive API.

## Capabilities

- **File access & discovery** — search files, retrieve full content (Docs as Markdown, Sheets as CSV, Slides/text as plain text, binaries as base64), stream large files in byte-range chunks, download thumbnails, and inspect the full Drive tree.
- **Upload & export** — upload files to Drive from a URL (up to 25 MB, any non-Workspace type), download or export files in supported formats, and retrieve binary content for downstream processing.
- **Folder & file management** — create folders, move files/folders (including rename-in-place), rename files, and list or traverse the full Drive hierarchy.
- **Permissions & sharing** — share files with specific people, update roles, revoke individual or bulk access, change general/link-sharing access (public, domain, restricted), list all collaborators, and check file accessibility in batch before attempting reads.
- **Picker integration** — generate a Google-hosted file picker URL so users can grant per-file access without exposing credentials; batch pre-flight checks (`CheckFileAccess`) identify which files need picker grants before any read attempt.
- **Account & environment info** — retrieve the authenticated user's profile, email, storage quota, and list of shared drives with their IDs.

## OAuth

This toolkit uses OAuth 2.0 via Google. See the [Arcade Google auth provider docs](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/references/auth-providers/google) for setup instructions.

## Secrets

### `ENABLE_GOOGLE_DRIVE_INLINE_PICKER_URL`

This secret controls whether `CheckFileAccess` and `GenerateGoogleFilePickerUrl` embed a ready-to-use Google Drive picker URL directly in their responses. When set, the toolkit constructs a picker URL scoped to the ungranted file IDs so the agent can hand the user a single link covering all missing grants in one step. Without it, the picker URL field is omitted and access grants must be handled separately.

This is not a credential issued by Google — it is a Arcade-side feature flag/configuration value. Set it in your Arcade secret store. The value format and how to obtain or configure it are documented in the Arcade secrets guide and dashboard:

- Secrets guide: https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets
- Secrets dashboard: https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets
